notes: A tetrahedral FM pluck (engine A, fan algorithm, ratios 1, 3:2, 4:3, 1, panned in 120° symmetry, high-pass 800 Hz) plays a 16-step pattern on steps 1, 4, 7 and 11 (pitches 0, +7, +5, 0) with a short 35% gate. A Wavetable sub-bass pad is side-chained to the FM layer (threshold 0.15, amount 70%) so it ducks on every pluck. Press PLAY to hear the sequence.
